scripts.build: npm run build -w @laces-out/api && npm run build -w @laces-out/worker && npm run build -w @laces-out/espn-bridge && npm run build -w @laces-out/web

scripts.runtime:smoke: npm run build -w @laces-out/api && npm run build -w @laces-out/worker && npm run build -w @laces-out/espn-bridge && npm run build -w @laces-out/web && node scripts/runtime-smoke.mjs
